Washington service areas

Explore online therapy by Washington region.

Washington telehealth guide

Regional pages explain access, not branch offices.

M.F.T. has one physical office in Woodinville. These pages help eligible clients understand statewide online care without implying a local clinic.

Online Therapy in SpokaneOnline therapy can reduce cross-town travel and widen the clinician search for eligible clients in Spokane, Spokane Valley, Liberty Lake, Cheney, Airway Heights, and nearby Washington communities.Online Therapy in YakimaA statewide telehealth option for eligible clients balancing work, school, caregiving, and travel across Yakima Valley communities.Online Therapy in eligible clients physically located in Washington, including Vancouver and nearby southwest Washington communities.Online Therapy in BothellClients near Bothell may consider the Woodinville office or
